notes.title: HotHead is Now Only $2.99
notes.content: HotHead has reduced in price to $2.99!

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale - 60% off ($1.99)
notes.content:
HotHead is on 60% off ($1.99) for Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. During Steam’s Lunar New Year Sale, qualifying purchases over $30 will receive an automatic discount of $5.

Offer ends February 11th.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Release
notes.content:
Patch notes for version 1.2.1
[list]
[*] Increased initial window size.
[*] Reduced blurriness on HotHead.
[*] Shield power up will now protect you from Stampers.
[*] Re-organized the Options menu.
[*] Added a list of the controls in the options menu.
[*] Added the ability to modify the volume of the music and sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Release - New Control Scheme
notes.content: A new update is available for HotHead. In the options settings you can now select "Keyboard & Mouse B" to use the "Space Bar" for jump and "Tab" key to pause.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Release - Achievements Added
notes.content:
An update for HotHead is now available. 18 achievements have been added to the game.

If you have previously played the game and already accomplished what you need for an achievement then the achievement will be awarded to you as soon as you start the game.

notes.title: HotHead is Now Available!
notes.content: HotHead is now available to purchase for $4.99.

notes.title: HotHead releases October 5th!
notes.content: HotHead now has an official release date for October 5th, just one week from today. Also, a new video has been added to the store page. Please, check it out if you haven't already and follow this page for more updates in the future.
